_readme: Template for harness_credentials.json, which the live conformance suite reads.
Copy this file to harness_credentials.json and fill in real tokens. That filename is
gitignored: this repository is public, so a real token committed here would be world-readable
and GitLab's secret scanning would revoke it.
The GitLab suite needs three identities on one project, not one. Approval semantics are the
reason: GitLab refuses to let an author approve their own MR, so a single-token harness cannot
tell 'approval worked' apart from 'approval was rejected'. An owner plus two developers lets
the suite open an MR as one user and approve it as another.
GitHub needs no token here. The suite reads `gh auth token`, so there is deliberately nothing
